description: What one publication's article should be built from, the same as the form on the client's order page. Each publication on an order needs its own. Needs at least who they are and what the article should say, or a draft of their own. Only while that publication is waiting for content; sending again replaces the earlier version. We then write an outline for the client to approve. Confirm the content with the client before sending.

about.description: Who the client is, in a few sentences.

angle.description: Their news, launch, milestone or point of view.

draft.description: A draft of their own, if they have one. Client-written articles are more likely to be turned down by editors, so expect edits.

facts.description: Proof points: numbers, results, credentials, awards, a quote from them in their exact words.

links.description: Up to three links; most publications allow two or three.

name.description: How the article should name them: a person, a business or a pen name.

orderLink.description: The client's private order link (https://theprofound.agency/order/<id>/#t=…), or just the token after #t=. It is the "Open your order page" button in the order confirmation email sent when the order is paid.

publication.description: Which publication on the order: its name or publicationId from get_client_order. Needed when the order has more than one; each publication has its own content, outline and draft.

name: submit_content
title: Send the client's content for their article
